description: Exploring the alphabet from A to Z through various iconic symbols and scenes.

sequence.title: alphabet_a_antelope
sequence.image: A is for Antelope, a majestic creature in a vast African savannah under a clear blue sky.
sequence.motion: The camera pans slowly from left to right, showcasing the wide-open landscape of the African savannah with the antelope standing majestically.

sequence.title: alphabet_b_balloon

sequence.motion: The camera captures the vibrant scene as the balloon rises gently into the sky, reflecting the joy of the festive atmosphere below.
